readings: Looking at spatial scan data (`scanspatial`) linked to projects (`projects.arcregistry` = `scanspatial.arcref`), which funding sources (`projects.fundflux`, treating a missing source as its own group) are bigger than average? For each funding source, work out the average ratio of bounding box Y (`boxy`) to bounding box Z (`boxz`), ignoring missing values, and how big it is. For the sources above the average size across funding sources, give one row with the average of their ratios, their combined size, and how far on average they exceed the average size. No rounding. queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS src,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS sz
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(sz) AS avg_sz FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.sz) AS total_size,
       AVG(g.sz - a.avg_sz) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.sz > a.avg_sz;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         SUM(s.aream2) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.size > a.avg_size;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS src,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         SUM(s.volm3) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(size - (SELECT AVG(size) FROM g)) AS avg_excess
FROM g
WHERE size > (SELECT AVG(size) FROM g);
WITH g AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') AS src,
         AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxz <> 0 THEN s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz END) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing')
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.size > a.avg_size;
